_note: A short look at each show's nominees, shown on its awards page until the winners are in (then Will's retrospective or the winners summary takes over). Paragraphs split on blank lines. Never name or predict a winner here.

country.2026:
Ella Langley leads the 2026 field with six nominations. Megan Moroney, Kacey Musgraves and Zach Top are right behind her with five each. Langley and Moroney go head to head in five categories: Entertainer, Female Vocalist, Album, Single and Song.

Those two also own the biggest hits in the running. ‘Wedding Dress’ spent seven weeks at #1 and ‘Choosin’ Texas’ spent six, and both are up for Single and Song of the Year. Every Single nominee reached #1. The one Song nominee that never got there is David Nail’s ‘Pacing the Cage,’ which stopped at #2.

Kevin Powers picked up four nominations in his New Artist year, two of them for ‘Move On’ with Shaboozey. Flatland Cavalry show up in both New Artist and Duo/Group. The winners are announced on CMA night, November 18.
